# RO Calculator — Copilot Workspace Instructions

## Project Overview

A **Ragnarok Online damage/DPS calculator** built with Angular 16, PrimeNG, and Supabase.

- **Live site:** https://ro-calculator.sanka.in.th/
- **Repository:** https://github.com/valkyrie2/ro-calculator
- **Deployed via:** GitHub Pages (`docs/` folder) with a custom domain (`ro-calculator.sanka.in.th`)

## Tech Stack

| Layer      | Technology                                      |
|------------|-------------------------------------------------|
| Framework  | Angular 16 (NgModule, AOT, esbuild)             |
| UI         | PrimeNG 16 + PrimeFlex 3.3, Vela Green theme    |
| Styling    | SCSS                                            |
| Backend    | Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Realtime)           |
| Auth       | Supabase Auth — email/password, PKCE flow       |
| State      | RxJS 7.8 (services + ReplaySubject)             |
| Language   | TypeScript 5.1                                  |
| Testing    | Karma + Jasmine (headless Chrome)               |
| Linting    | ESLint (`no-explicit-any: warn`, `no-console: warn`) |

## Key Conventions

- **Logging:** Use `LoggerService` (DI) or the `logger` singleton. Never use `console.log` directly — ESLint flags it. `logger.error()` always passes through in production; other levels are no-ops.
- **Skill names:** `src/app/constants/skill-name.ts` intentionally preserves in-game typos (`Fatal Manace`, `Lightening Bolt`). Do not fix them.
- **Item data:** `src/assets/demo/data/item.json` — flat JSON keyed by item ID string. Use the `add-item` agent to add new items.
- **Bonus keys:** Only use documented bonus attribute keys from `src/app/api-services/valid-bonuses.ts`. Never guess or invent keys.
- **Supabase secrets:** `src/environments/supabase.secrets.ts` is gitignored. Copy from `supabase.secrets.example.ts` to set up locally.
- **base-href:** The build uses `--base-href /` (custom domain served from root). Do not change to `/ro-calculator/`.
- **CNAME:** `src/CNAME` contains `ro-calculator.sanka.in.th` and is included in Angular assets so it is copied to `docs/` on every build.

## Important Files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src/assets/demo/data/item.json` | All equipment, cards, shadow gear |
| `src/app/constants/enchant_item/_enchant_table.ts` | Enchant slot registration |
| `src/app/api-services/valid-bonuses.ts` | Allowed bonus attribute keys |
| `src/app/constants/skill-name.ts` | Skill name constants (preserve typos) |
| `src/app/jobs/_character-base.abstract.ts` | Base class for all 55+ jobs |
| `src/environments/supabase.secrets.ts` | **gitignored** — Supabase URL + anon key |
| `src/CNAME` | Custom domain declaration for GitHub Pages |
| `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` | CI/CD — builds to `docs/` and deploys to GitHub Pages |
| `package.json` `predeploy` script | `ng build --output-hashing all --output-path docs --base-href /` |

## Deployment

- **Trigger:** Push to `main` runs `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`
- **Build output:** `docs/` folder (gitignored, generated by CI)
- **Custom domain:** `ro-calculator.sanka.in.th` — set in GitHub Pages settings and maintained by `src/CNAME`
- **Old URL:** `https://valkyrie2.github.io/ro-calculator/` — GitHub Pages auto-redirects to the custom domain

## Supabase Auth URL Configuration

In the Supabase Dashboard → Authentication → URL Configuration:

- **Site URL:** `https://ro-calculator.sanka.in.th/`
- **Redirect URLs:**
  - `http://localhost:4200/**`
  - `https://ro-calculator.sanka.in.th/**`

## Specialist Agents & Skills

- **`add-item` agent** — Add new items to `item.json` from raw JSON data
- **`reference-calculator` skill** — Damage pipeline, equipment/card system, item scripts
- **`reference-calculator-frontend` skill** — UI conventions, Vela Green theme, PrimeNG patterns
- **`reference-preset-system` skill** — Preset save/load, cloud sync, sharing
